Paper Name: HOMER optimization of standalone PV/Wind/Battery powered hydrogen refueling stations located at twenty selected French cities
NOTES: Paper reports three scenarios; Scenario 3 (PV-Battery) identified as winner/optimal. LCOE, LCOH, NPC values vary by city (20 cities) — only ranges reported in abstract. No single baseline value. LCOE reported as cost of energy ($/kWh), not COE (cost of electricity). NPC reported instead of COE. System is 100% renewable — no diesel generator, no fuel cell used. H2 storage tank cost unit in Table 1 listed as $/kW. Battery (Generic 1kWh Lead Acid) used in all scenarios but no corresponding column in extraction schema. Electrolyzer efficiency reported as 85% of HHV. Annual real discount rate = 3.92%, inflation = 2%. Project lifetime = 25 years.
